comparison.objective: Extract exactly one nested paper cup through a dispenser gasket and stand it on a mat; candidate performs dry media/part screening.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant single-item extraction without crushing or releasing extra cups versus controlled pouring and bimanual granular-flow control.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one undamaged cup upright, released and wholly on the mat; candidate requires complete loading, ≥98% media recovery, retained washers and no spill or contamination.
comparison.reason: The cup task tests compliant extraction and singulation, not sieve-mediated material separation.
